title: Extension of scalars preserves K-flat quasi-isomorphisms
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings in one universe and rho:R→B a ring homomorphism. Termwise ModuleCat.extendScalars rho sends every quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] between unbounded K-flat complexes of R-modules [def-pc-module-kflat-complex] to a quasi-isomorphism of B-module complexes. No flatness of rho, boundedness, or choice of a derived category is assumed.

source.place: Tags 064L and 06Y0; mixed tensor with the target ring in degree zero

proof.text: Reuse the existing private scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_kFlat proof in KFlatScalarExtensionDerivedIso. Its proof applies the first clause of mixedTensor_kFlat_quasiIso to the B-module tensor unit in degree zero. The natural single-complex comparison and tensor left unitor identify that total tensor with termwise extension of scalars. Their naturality yields arrow isomorphisms; quasi-isomorphism is invariant under these. Pack this property into the existing proposition-valued PreservesKFlatQuasiIso class.

proof_origin.note: Reuses the existing private proof instead of reproving the tensor calculation. Local rg search found this helper; no public property declaration remains after the S3 repair was reverted.
